gameLocalization.note: Exact game IDs distinguish shared Japanese names. Guide spelling and ellipsis variants are resolved against these paired localization records.

lead.text: Stop the adds' Offense Level Down to prevent Hindley's conditional bonuses. Defeating adds increases his actions but also lowers his Offense Level. Check the added attacks, then use Slash and winning Clashes to finish him.

listLead.text: Prevent add debuffs to deny the boss's conditional bonuses. Defeating adds increases its actions but lowers its Offense Level. Handle the extra attacks while finishing it.

statNote.text: The Regular Encounter in 6-31. Hindley is Level 42 with 869 HP and Defense Level 42. The 5 Sharp and 4 Fierce Henchmen are Level 40 with 176 HP and Defense Level 32. Check initial placement and extra actions in battle. Hindley's and Sharp Henchmen's Stagger values are unconfirmed and are not filled with estimates. Do not substitute 6-32's form or 6-33's henchman values and attack types.

skillNote.text: 5 boss skills and 4 per add. Distinguish base rolls from bonuses based on target Offense Level Down and negative effects. The henchmen's “Get... Out of My...” and “Remo...ve...” are Blunt in this encounter.

priorities.0.text: Aim for Level 42 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Bring Slash for Hindley and Gloom/Envy damage for adds.

priorities.1.text: Prevent the adds' Offense Level Down. Keep “Get Crushed” away from heavily debuffed Sinners.

priorities.2.text: Add deaths grant Hindley up to 3 extra actions while lowering his Offense Level according to the number defeated. Recheck Clashes after cleanup and damage him.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The boss's attacks suddenly become much more dangerous

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: The adds' Offense Level Down enables Hindley's extra damage and power bonuses. “Get Crushed” prioritizes debuffed targets, so prevent add hits first.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: You are unsure whether to defeat the adds

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Each defeat lowers Hindley's Offense Level here. His actions increase by up to 3, so remove debuff sources while checking that you can answer the extra attacks. Do not directly apply 6-33's plan of leaving adds alive.

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Guard gains 20 extra Shield per other living ally. Offset it, or defeat adds to limit both extra Shield and disruption.

units.0.notes.0.text: Starts with 3 slots. Ally deaths add up to 3 more from the following turn.

units.0.notes.1.text: From the following turn, gain 2 Offense Level Down according to the number of defeated allies.

units.0.notes.2.text: Hindley does not inflict Offense Level Down by himself. Preventing the adds' debuffs matters.

units.1.notes.0.text: 5 across the battle. Inflicts Offense Level Down and increases Rupture Count.

units.1.notes.1.text: On Clash Lose, deals 3 SP damage to the opponent who won.

units.2.notes.0.text: 4 across the battle. Inflicts Defense Level Down and Rupture Potency.

units.2.notes.1.text: On Clash Lose, deals 3 SP damage to the opponent who won.

phases.0.title.text: Limit disruption and prepare for the extra actions after cleanup

phases.0.steps.0.text: Adds are weak to Gloom and Envy. Prevent Sharp Henchmen's Offense Level Down to deny Hindley's extra-damage conditions.

phases.0.steps.1.text: In this Regular Encounter, check actual targets and Clash pairings. If replacing a losing attack with defense, still confirm who receives each attack.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Defeating adds increases Hindley's slots from next turn, up to 3 extra. Build SP and prepare powerful skills before the action count rises.

phases.1.title.text: Use reduced Offense Level to damage the boss

phases.1.steps.0.text: From next turn, Hindley gains 2 Offense Level Down according to defeated ally count. Answer his extra actions using predictions after that reduction.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Slash deals 1.25× damage to Hindley; Pierce is halved. Use effective damage and watch attacks aimed at Sinners still carrying add debuffs.

phases.1.steps.2.text: “Get Crushed” prioritizes the target with the most negative effects. Check its Offense Level Down bonuses and reuse at 3 or more debuffs, then assign a strong answer.

phases.2.title.text: Stop hit-triggered buffs and finish the fight

phases.2.steps.0.text: “Damn Plebs...!” hits and later Coins of “Make Things Right Again” restore the enemy's Offense Level or SP. Avoid repeated unopposed hits even after his action count rises.

phases.2.steps.1.text: At -10 SP or less, Hindley gains 3 Offense Level Up next turn. Lowering SP does not stop every buff; check Clash predictions.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Use actual in-battle Stagger Thresholds and concentrate damage when he Staggers. Do not make unconfirmed percentages fixed damage targets.

skills.0.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.0.response.text: Each Coin's hit grants 1 Offense Level Up next turn. Use it as an early Clash target to prevent hit-triggered buffs.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal additional Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt.

skills.1.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal additional Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt.

skills.1.response.text: Against Offense Level Down, each hit adds Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt. Keep it away from Sinners debuffed by the adds.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [Clash Win] If the target has at least 2 Offense Level Down, gain +1 Base Power.

skills.2.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal +30% damage.

skills.2.response.text: Deals +30% damage [On Use] against Offense Level Down. The later Coins of this 4-Coin skill also heal enemy SP, so prevent hits on debuffed main units.

skills.3.effects.0.text: Prioritize the target with the most negative effects.

skills.3.effects.1.text: [Clash Win] Gain +1 Coin Power per 3 target Offense Level Down, up to 3.

skills.3.effects.5.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal +30% damage per 2 target Offense Level Down, up to 120%.

skills.3.effects.6.text: [Heads Hit] If the target has at least 3 negative effects, reuse this Coin once at most.

skills.3.response.text: Prioritizes the most-debuffed target. Offense Level Down adds bonuses, while 3 or more debuffs enable second-Coin reuse. Check the remaining HP of heavily debuffed Sinners.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain 20 additional Shield per other living ally.

skills.4.response.text: Gains 20 extra Shield per other living ally at Combat Start. While many adds remain, prioritize offsetting or cleanup rather than wasting weak attacks on it.

skills.5.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3.

skills.5.response.text: Increases Rupture Count by 3. Even with 1 Coin, it prolongs fixed damage on high-Rupture Sinners; do not underestimate it.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 3 Rupture Count, gain +1 Base Power.

skills.6.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Offense Level Down.

skills.6.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Offense Level Down.

skills.6.response.text: Stacks Offense Level Down and Rupture, also strengthening Hindley's later attacks. Prevent hits. This regular henchman's attack is Blunt, unlike the Pierce attack of 6-33's covered henchmen.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Use] Deal 3 SP damage to the target.

skills.7.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Base Power per 3 Rupture Count, up to 3.

skills.7.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 4.

skills.7.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Offense Level Down.

skills.7.response.text: Deals 3 SP damage [On Use]. Rupture Count raises Base Power by up to +3, with Bleed, Offense Level Down, and Paralyze on top. Use an answer that wins after those bonuses.

skills.8.effects.0.text: If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Final Power.

skills.8.response.text: A normal Blunt Counter. Gains +1 Final Power against Rupture and inflicts 2 Bleed on hit. Avoid weak unopposed attacks that cannot withstand the Counter.

skills.9.response.text: A 1-Coin attack applying 4 Rupture. Stop it with a winning Clash or Stagger before combining with enemies that raise Rupture Count.

skills.10.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 3 Rupture Potency, gain +1 Base Power.

skills.10.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down.

skills.10.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down.

skills.10.response.text: Gains +1 Base Power at 3 Rupture Potency and stacks Defense Level Down with Rupture Count. Avoid repeated hits on the same Sinner. The 6-31 henchman uses Blunt.

skills.11.effects.0.text: [On Use] Deal 3 SP damage to the target.

skills.11.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Base Power per 4 Rupture Potency, up to 3.

skills.11.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down.

skills.11.response.text: Deals 3 SP damage [On Use] and gains up to +3 Base Power from Rupture Potency. Limit Bleed, Defense Level Down, and next-turn Paralyze.

skills.12.effects.0.text: If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Final Power.

skills.12.response.text: A normal Counter with +1 Final Power against Rupture. Check the first attacker's HP and Blunt resistance.

passives.0.response.text: Do not rely on Panic to keep him disabled for long.

passives.1.condition.text: At -10 SP or less at Turn End

passives.1.effect.text: Gain 3 Offense Level Up next turn.

passives.1.response.text: Check next turn's Offense Level buff even at low SP.

passives.2.effect.text: Gain 1 additional slot from next turn onward.

passives.2.response.text: Save enough skills to answer extra attacks after add cleanup.

passives.3.effect.text: From next turn, gain 2 Offense Level Down according to the number of defeated allies.

passives.3.response.text: Do not preserve every add just to avoid extra actions. Remove debuff sources and use the resulting weakening too.

passives.4.condition.text: Wins after at least 5 Clash rolls

passives.4.response.text: Losing a long Clash also increases incoming damage. Choose a winning skill or defense.

passives.5.condition.text: At Combat Start, target is the enemy with the lowest HP

passives.5.response.text: Avoid repeated attacks on a low-HP Sinner.

passives.6.effect.text: Deal 3 SP damage to the opponent.

passives.6.response.text: Winning still costs SP, but prevents hit-triggered debuffs.

passives.7.response.text: Keep attacking during Panic to finish the enemy before recovery.

passives.8.condition.text: At Combat Start, target is the enemy with the lowest HP

passives.8.response.text: Avoid repeated attacks on a low-HP Sinner.

passives.9.effect.text: Deal 3 SP damage to the opponent.

passives.9.response.text: Winning still costs SP, but prevents hit-triggered debuffs.

passives.10.response.text: Keep attacking during Panic to finish the enemy before recovery.

mechanics.0.name.text: Follow-up damage against Offense Level Down

mechanics.0.effect.text: Offense Level Down inflicted by adds enables the boss's extra damage, damage bonuses, and Coin Power bonuses.

mechanics.0.response.text: Prevent Sharp Henchmen's hits as well as Hindley's attacks.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Ally deaths grant Hindley up to 3 extra slots from next turn. He also receives Offense Level Down according to the number defeated.

mechanics.1.response.text: Prepare for extra actions while removing debuff sources and exploiting the weakening.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Deployed Heathcliff normally gains SP-draining Bereavement. His Wild Hunt Identity changes it to Unending Bereavement.

mechanics.2.response.text: He is not mandatory here, so consider another main unit if maintaining SP is difficult.

warnings.0.text: 6-31 is a Regular Encounter. Do not assume you can freely redirect attacks as in Focused Encounters.

warnings.1.text: Hindley's and Sharp Henchmen's Stagger values are unconfirmed. Do not plan around estimated percentages.

warnings.2.text: Add deaths have different effects here than against the Dead Rabbits Boss in 6-33.

warnings.3.text: Henchman skills here are Blunt. Do not substitute 6-33's Pierce attacks.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Level 42 and Uptie III or higher on your main units, with Slash and Gloom/Envy damage.

preparation.1.text: Enemy attacks are mainly Blunt. Check resistances and HP to limit repeated Rupture/Bleed damage.

preparation.2.text: Prepare SP recovery and powerful E.G.O to handle Hindley's extra actions.

roles.0.reason.text: Use Gloom/Envy to remove debuff sources and lower Hindley's Offense Level.

roles.1.reason.text: Avoid halved Pierce damage and finish the boss after add cleanup.

roles.2.reason.text: Handle extra actions after add deaths and attacks targeting debuffed Sinners.
